cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Basically Finished
cards.instruction: Describe incomplete, late, or improvised work as a thoughtful version of completion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Here's the finished budget report. Just the title page: I've left room for contributions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The board meets in ten minutes. They need your figures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It's the discussion edition. They can supply their figures directly, without reading mine first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chair wants a recommendation, not a discussion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll add 'Approve' beneath the title. Finished decision edition. We've eliminated the discussion entirely.

mechanism: A uses editorial distinctions between report editions to sell a title-only budget document as intentionally complete, then reframes one added recommendation as a finished decision product.
confusable: Minimalism can be legitimate; B must make the absent figures and immediate decision need explicit so A reclassification covers actual incomplete work.
comparison: Cupboard alternative changes physical completion stages; report alternative changes the claimed purpose of the deliverable.
seedUse: Title page, imminent board and recommendation derive from D41-b; S03 adds reader workflow and executive-format corrections.
